final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), t AS (SELECT st, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(t.share) AS avg_share, AVG(t.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.share > a.avg_share
